title: Frame – 31.5" color ePaper display
why_read: A large-format, low-power ePaper display product that appeals to hardware/hobbyist engineers interested in display tech and power-efficient design.
analysis: This is a hardware product announcement for a 31.5-inch color ePaper display, likely aimed at art displays or ambient information panels. ePaper at this size and in color is still relatively uncommon and technically interesting, given manufacturing and driver challenges for large-format reflective displays. The appeal is mostly to hardware tinkerers and display-tech enthusiasts rather than software engineers broadly. It's a product showcase rather than deep technical writeup, so interest is moderate.
